title: Fast Car
hook: Why Fast Car feels like *escaping but never leaving*

chords.name: Dmaj7
chords.text: It starts on *Dmaj7*, the IV. Already dreaming.

chords.name: A
chords.text: *A*, home. The place you want to leave.

chords.name: E
chords.text: The V. *G♯ reaches for home*, but…

chords.name: Dmaj7
chords.text: …it drives back to D. *Escape never lands*.

question: Tracy Chapman or Luke Combs version? 👇
